hero.description: TIDE Foundation works to bring sustainable, systemic change to India's education landscape through six independent projects — built to last, designed to disappear.

mission.title: Education as the silver bullet
mission.body: Access to quality education is the key to unlocking India's social challenges. We work intensively with communities — not superficially across many — to build change that grows from within.
mission.quote: A sustainable change requires deep understanding of the complex system.

projects.title: Six projects. One vision.
projects.subtitle: Each initiative targets a different root cause in the education system, working independently toward the same north star.

cta.title: Be part of the change
cta.body: Whether you donate time, resources, or expertise — there's a place for you in TIDE's mission.

testimonial.quote: TIDE doesn't just run programs — it builds ecosystems. Their work with our teachers changed how our entire school thinks about education.
testimonial.name: School Principal, Ahmedabad

whyTide.title: Why TIDE?
whyTide.subtitle: We exist to create change that outlasts us.
whyTide.mission: TIDE Foundation (Together in Development and Education) was established on November 14, 2014 with a singular mission: to bring about contextualized, grass root level, sustainable changes in India's education sector.
whyTide.vision: Our vision is bold — to deplete the need for our own projects within 15 years, either by systemically resolving root issues or by developing independent systems that no longer need our support.
whyTide.philosophy: We believe simple, well-aimed interventions can create domino effects throughout communities. Rather than spreading thin across many places, we work intensively with fewer communities to catalyse organic, lasting transformation.

goals.title: Five Primary Goals
goals.g2: Create leaders equipped with creative and critical thinking
goals.g3: Build holistic environments — heart, head, and hands
goals.g4: Establish application-based learning for critical reasoning
goals.g5: Elevate education quality in government and municipal schools

bettered.title: BetterED
bettered.overview: BetterED addresses learning gaps through structured after-school programs in urban slums — evolving from weekly games sessions to a comprehensive five-to-six-day-a-week educational model.
bettered.focus: Life skills, arts, dance, theatre, public speaking and storytelling
bettered.goal: A scalable, volunteer-driven intervention that can reach hundreds of schools citywide.

empowered.title: EmpowerEd
empowered.overview: EmpowerEd develops bottom-up, collaborative interventions to educate, enrich and empower educators. It treats teachers as experts — not recipients — of professional development.
empowered.goals: Build teacher agency · Share best practices · Facilitate experiential learning · Build professional communities · Drive systemic change
empowered.component1desc: Fortnightly dialogue sessions, small-group projects, action research, reading groups, and best-practice documentation.
empowered.component2desc: Rich storytelling and game-based decision-making scenarios rooted in diverse household experiences.
empowered.phase2: Phase 2 (Nov 2022–Jun 2024): Pre-pilot with ~50 teachers; app pilot with ~10,000 teachers
empowered.phase3: Phase 3 (Jun 2024–Jun 2025): Scale to ~100,000 teachers across one Indian state
empowered.phase4: Phase 4 (Jun 2025–Jun 2028): Expand to 10–30 million teachers across India and internationally

completed.title: CompletEd
completed.tagline: Education through, as, and for social justice.
completed.overview: CompletEd engages students and communities in social change through four distinct sub-programs, fostering civic awareness, leadership, and a commitment to the Sustainable Development Goals.
completed.scfDesc: A prestigious program fostering social leadership among young people.
completed.sdgDesc: Volunteering initiatives directly aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
completed.mccDesc: A public engagement event promoting civic participation and collaborative problem-solving.
completed.moiDesc: A platform showcasing innovative solutions — editions in 2017, 2023, and 2024.

blockETI.title: Block Educational Transformation Initiative
blockETI.tagline: Systemic change at the block level.
blockETI.overview: A comprehensive initiative working at the government school block level to transform foundational learning, life skills, and teacher empowerment — at scale.

thrive.title: THRIvE Research Centre
thrive.fullName: Transformative Holistic Research for Integral and Inclusive Education
thrive.tagline: Where rigorous inquiry meets real-world impact.
thrive.overview: THRIvE is committed to creating transformative, inclusive, and equitable education systems through deep inquiry, strategic collaboration, holistic approaches, and actionable insights.

principles.title: Core Principles
principles.p1desc: Producing evidence-based research to guide systemic improvements.
principles.p2desc: Examining stakeholder experiences and systemic factors influencing behaviour.
principles.p3desc: Investigating why policies and interventions succeed or fail.
principles.p4desc: Ensuring insights drive tangible educational change.
principles.p5desc: Building long-term partnerships that foster institutional innovation.
principles.p6desc: Equipping educators with research skills for sustainable change.

projects.title: Current Research Projects
projects.p1desc: Exploring teacher and student experiences with social-emotional development curricula.
projects.p2desc: Examining teacher agency as a catalyst for educational change across India.
projects.p3desc: Investigating professional experiences and identity among disabled educators.
projects.p4desc: Autoethnographic study of student engagement in immersive social justice projects.
projects.p5desc: Qualitative study of collaborative sustainability discussions and civic education.
